import os
import glob
from abc import ABC
from gpio_service.common.ledprogrambase import LedProgramBase
from gpio_service.layoutsettings import LayoutSettings

LED_PROGRAMS_DIR = "ledprograms"

# -----------------------------
# Led program repository responsible for loading/changing between different led programs
# -----------------------------
class LedProgramRepository:

  def __init__(self, settings, leds):
    self.programs = {}
    self.settings = settings
    
    programTypes = self.importFromFolder(LED_PROGRAMS_DIR, LedProgramBase)
    print("Initializing Led Programs: ", end = "")
    for i, programType in enumerate(programTypes):
      programName = programType.__name__
      if (i == len(programTypes) - 1):
        print(programName, end = "")
      else:
        print(programName, end = ", ")
      self.add(programType(settings, leds))
    print(" <- Success!")  

    programList = list(self.programs.items())
    programList.sort()
    self.programs = dict(programList)
    if (self.settings.mode not in self.programs):
      self.changeMode(self.settings.mode)
    self.currentProgram = self.programs[self.settings.mode]
    #Log
    #print("Settings: isOn:"+str(self.settings.isOn)+" mode:"+str(self.settings.mode)+" toggle:"
    #+str(self.settings.toggle)+" speed:"+str(self.settings.speed)+" brightness:"+str(self.settings.brightness)+" ledCount:"+str(self.settings.ledCount))

  # -----------------------------
  # Runs current program frame
  # -----------------------------
  def show(self):
    self.currentProgram.show()

  # -----------------------------
  # Changes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def changeMode(self, newMode, setProgram = False):
    if not self.programs:
      raise ValueError("No registered LED programs")

    registered_ids = sorted(self.programs.keys())
    lowest = registered_ids[0]
    highest = registered_ids[-1]

    current = self.settings.mode

    if newMode is None or current is None:
      mode = lowest
    elif newMode in self.programs:
      mode = newMode
    elif newMode > current:
      mode = lowest
      for i in registered_ids:
        if i >= newMode:
          mode = i
          break
    else:
      mode = highest
      for i in reversed(registered_ids):
        if i <= newMode:
          mode = i
          break

    self.settings.mode = mode
    if setProgram:
      self.currentProgram = self.programs[mode]
      self.reinitializeLedProgram()

  # -----------------------------
  # Reinitializes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def reinitializeLedProgram(self):
    self.currentProgram.initialize()

  # -----------------------------
  # Gets current led program layout settings
  # -----------------------------
  def getModeLayout(self):
    modeLayout = LayoutSettings()
    modeLayout.modeIndex = self.currentProgram.modeIndex
    modeLayout.minSpeed = self.currentProgram.minSpeed
    modeLayout.maxSpeed = self.currentProgram.maxSpeed
    modeLayout.modes = []

    for i in self.programs:
      modeLayout.modes.append((self.programs[i].modeIndex, self.programs[i].modeName))

    return modeLayout

  # -----------------------------

  # -----------------------------

    if (ledProgram.modeIndex in self.programs):
      raise ValueError("Error. LedProgram of index '"+str(ledProgram.modeIndex)+"' already exists in LedProgramRepository")
    self.programs[ledProgram.modeIndex] = ledProgram

    programTypes = []
    currentDir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

import pytest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from gpio_service.ledprogramrepository import LedProgramRepository


class FakeProgram:
    def __init__(self, mode_index, name="P"):
        self.modeIndex = mode_index
        self.modeName = name
        self.initialize_count = 0

    def initialize(self):
        self.initialize_count += 1

    def show(self):
        pass


def make_repo(programs, mode=None):
    repo = object.__new__(LedProgramRepository)
    repo.programs = {}
    repo.settings = SimpleNamespace(mode=mode)
    for p in programs:
        repo.programs[p.modeIndex] = p
    repo.currentProgram = repo.programs[mode] if mode is not None and mode in repo.programs else None
    return repo


def test_empty_registry_raises_and_preserves_state():
    repo = make_repo([], mode=5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        repo.changeMode(3)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 5
    assert repo.programs == {}


def test_sparse_ids_without_one_none_selects_lowest():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    p30 = FakeProgram(30)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20, p30], mode=20)
    repo.changeMode(None)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 10


def test_exact_registered_id_selects_itself():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    p30 = FakeProgram(30)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20, p30], mode=10)
    repo.changeMode(20)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 20


def test_gap_above_wraps_to_lowest():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    p30 = FakeProgram(30)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20, p30], mode=20)
    repo.changeMode(25)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 30


def test_gap_below_wraps_to_highest():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    p30 = FakeProgram(30)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20, p30], mode=20)
    repo.changeMode(15)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 10


def test_current_none_selects_lowest():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20], mode=None)
    repo.changeMode(15)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 10


def test_set_program_false_does_not_initialize():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20], mode=10)
    repo.changeMode(20, setProgram=False)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 20
    assert p20.initialize_count == 0


def test_set_program_true_initializes_once():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20], mode=10)
    repo.changeMode(20, setProgram=True)
    assert repo.settings.mode == 20
    assert repo.currentProgram is p20
    assert p20.initialize_count == 1
    assert p10.initialize_count == 0


def test_registry_preserved_after_change():
    p10 = FakeProgram(10)
    p20 = FakeProgram(20)
    p30 = FakeProgram(30)
    repo = make_repo([p10, p20, p30], mode=10)
    repo.changeMode(20, setProgram=True)
    assert set(repo.programs.keys()) == {10, 20, 30}
    assert repo.programs[10] is p10
    assert repo.programs[20] is p20
    assert repo.programs[30] is p30

import importlib
import inspect
import os
import glob
from abc import ABC
from gpio_service.common.ledprogrambase import LedProgramBase
from gpio_service.layoutsettings import LayoutSettings

LED_PROGRAMS_DIR = "ledprograms"

# -----------------------------
# Led program repository responsible for loading/changing between different led programs
# -----------------------------
class LedProgramRepository:

  def __init__(self, settings, leds):
    self.programs = {}
    self.settings = settings
    
    programTypes = self.importFromFolder(LED_PROGRAMS_DIR, LedProgramBase)
    print("Initializing Led Programs: ", end = "")
    for i, programType in enumerate(programTypes):
      programName = programType.__name__
      if (i == len(programTypes) - 1):
        print(programName, end = "")
      else:
        print(programName, end = ", ")
      self.add(programType(settings, leds))
    print(" <- Success!")  

    programList = list(self.programs.items())
    programList.sort()
    self.programs = dict(programList)
    if (self.settings.mode not in self.programs):
      self.changeMode(self.settings.mode)
    self.currentProgram = self.programs[self.settings.mode]
    #Log
    #print("Settings: isOn:"+str(self.settings.isOn)+" mode:"+str(self.settings.mode)+" toggle:"
    #+str(self.settings.toggle)+" speed:"+str(self.settings.speed)+" brightness:"+str(self.settings.brightness)+" ledCount:"+str(self.settings.ledCount))

  # -----------------------------
  # Runs current program frame
  # -----------------------------
  def show(self):
    self.currentProgram.show()

  # -----------------------------
  # Changes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def changeMode(self, newMode, setProgram = False):
    if not self.programs:
      raise ValueError("No registered LED modes")

    registered_ids = list(self.programs.keys())
    lowest_id = min(registered_ids)
    highest_id = max(registered_ids)

    if newMode is None or self.settings.mode is None:
      mode = lowest_id
    elif newMode in self.programs:
      mode = newMode
    else:
      if newMode > self.settings.mode:
        candidates = [i for i in registered_ids if i >= newMode]
        if candidates:
          mode = min(candidates)
        else:
          mode = lowest_id
      else:
        candidates = [i for i in registered_ids if i <= newMode]
        if candidates:
          mode = max(candidates)
        else:
          mode = highest_id

    self.settings.mode = mode
    if setProgram:
      self.currentProgram = self.programs[mode]
      self.reinitializeLedProgram()

  # -----------------------------
  # Reinitializes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def reinitializeLedProgram(self):
    self.currentProgram.initialize()

  # -----------------------------
  # Gets current led program layout settings
  # -----------------------------
  def getModeLayout(self):
    modeLayout = LayoutSettings()
    modeLayout.modeIndex = self.currentProgram.modeIndex
    modeLayout.minSpeed = self.currentProgram.minSpeed
    modeLayout.maxSpeed = self.currentProgram.maxSpeed
    modeLayout.modes = []

    for i in self.programs:
      modeLayout.modes.append((self.programs[i].modeIndex, self.programs[i].modeName))

    return modeLayout

  # -----------------------------
  # Adds led program into repository
  # -----------------------------
  def add(self, ledProgram):
    if (ledProgram.modeIndex in self.programs):
      raise ValueError("Error. LedProgram of index '"+str(ledProgram.modeIndex)+"' already exists in LedProgramRepository")
    self.programs[ledProgram.modeIndex] = ledProgram
    
  # -----------------------------
  # Imports led programs which implements LedProgramBase from ledprograms folder 
  # -----------------------------
  def importFromFolder(self, directoryPath, baseClass=None, filterAbstract=True):    
    programTypes = []
    currentDir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    dirPath = os.path.join(currentDir, directoryPath)
    packageName = "gpio_service." + os.path.basename(directoryPath)

    # -----------------------------
    # Iterate all python files within that directory
    filePaths = glob.glob(os.path.join(dirPath, "*.py"))
    for filePath in filePaths:
      programFileName = os.path.basename(filePath)

      className = os.path.splitext(programFileName)[0]

      if className.startswith("__"):
        continue

      # -----------------------------
      # Import python file
      module = importlib.import_module("." + className, package=packageName)

      # -----------------------------
      # Iterate items inside imported python file
      for item in dir(module):
        value = getattr(module, item)
        if not value:
          continue

        if not inspect.isclass(value):
          continue

        if filterAbstract and inspect.isabstract(value):
          continue

        if baseClass is not None:
          if type(value) != type(baseClass):
            continue
          
        if value.__name__ == ABC.__name__:
          continue
        
        programTypes.append(value)

    return programTypes

class LedProgramRepository:

  def __init__(self, settings, leds):
    self.programs = {}
    self.settings = settings
    
    programTypes = self.importFromFolder(LED_PROGRAMS_DIR, LedProgramBase)
    print("Initializing Led Programs: ", end = "")
    for i, programType in enumerate(programTypes):
      programName = programType.__name__
      if (i == len(programTypes) - 1):
        print(programName, end = "")
      else:
        print(programName, end = ", ")
      self.add(programType(settings, leds))
    print(" <- Success!")  

    programList = list(self.programs.items())
    programList.sort()
    self.programs = dict(programList)
    if (self.settings.mode not in self.programs):
      self.changeMode(self.settings.mode)
    self.currentProgram = self.programs[self.settings.mode]
    #Log

  # -----------------------------
  # Runs current program frame
  # -----------------------------
  def show(self):
    self.currentProgram.show()

  # -----------------------------
  # Changes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def changeMode(self, newMode, setProgram = False):
    if not self.programs:
      raise ValueError("No registered LED modes")

    registered_ids = list(self.programs.keys())
    lowest_id = min(registered_ids)
    highest_id = max(registered_ids)

    if newMode is None or self.settings.mode is None:
      mode = lowest_id
    elif newMode in self.programs:
      mode = newMode
    else:
      if newMode > self.settings.mode:
        candidates = [i for i in registered_ids if i >= newMode]
        if candidates:
          mode = min(candidates)
        else:
          mode = lowest_id
      else:
        candidates = [i for i in registered_ids if i <= newMode]
        if candidates:
          mode = max(candidates)
        else:
          mode = highest_id

    self.settings.mode = mode
    if setProgram:
      self.currentProgram = self.programs[mode]
      self.reinitializeLedProgram()

  # -----------------------------
  # Reinitializes led program
  # -----------------------------
  def reinitializeLedProgram(self):
    self.currentProgram.initialize()

  # -----------------------------

    modeLayout = LayoutSettings()
    modeLayout.modeIndex = self.currentProgram.modeIndex
    modeLayout.minSpeed = self.currentProgram.minSpeed
    modeLayout.maxSpeed = self.currentProgram.maxSpeed
    modeLayout.modes = []

    programTypes = []

    packageName = "gpio_service." + os.path.basename(directoryPath)

    # Iterate all python files within that directory
    filePaths = glob.glob(os.path.join(dirPath, "*.py"))
    for filePath in filePaths:
      programFileName = os.path.basename(filePath)

      className = os.path.splitext(programFileName)[0]

      if className.startswith("__"):
        continue

      # -----------------------------
      # Import python file
      module = importlib.import_module("." + className, package=packageName)

      # -----------------------------
      # Iterate items inside imported python file
      for item in dir(module):
        value = getattr(module, item)
        if not value:

        if not inspect.isclass(value):
          continue

        if filterAbstract and inspect.isabstract(value):
          continue

        if baseClass is not None:
          if type(value) != type(baseClass):
            continue
          
        if value.__name__ == ABC.__name__:
          continue
